name: go-database-sql-control
description: database/sql control on Go's database/sql and pgx v5.11.0 stdlib. No GORM. The pool is database/sql with MaxOpenConns equal to pool_max. sql.Tx.Commit returns the error from driver.Tx.Commit. pgx stdlib wrapTx.Commit calls pgx.Tx.Commit, so a ROLLBACK command tag becomes pgx.ErrTxCommitRollback at sql.Tx.Commit if pgx returns that error. The command tag itself is not a database/sql result. Nested transactions are SAVEPOINT SQL, because database/sql has no savepoint type. Category C faults use the same pgx QueryTracer as the native pgx control, under this driver. Category D discards the parsed commit inside a driver.Tx wrapper, after pgx.Tx.Commit returns and before database/sql returns to the caller. The mode is not harness kind control.

modes.description: sql.DB.BeginTx, sql.Tx.Commit, and sql.Tx.Rollback. sql.TxOptions.Isolation is set for TX-05. A nil Commit error is reported as committed. pgx.ErrTxCommitRollback is reported as rolled_back. Any other Commit or Rollback error is reported as failed. The pool is database/sql, not pgxpool. stdlib ResetSession still returns driver.ErrBadConn when the pgx transaction status is not idle.

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: database/sql has no propagation mode and no API that commits an inner transaction while an outer transaction stays open. A SAVEPOINT stays on the same connection and the same transaction. This adapter does not open a second connection and call it an independent transaction.

TX-05.managed-serializable.reason: database/sql has no managed callback API that commits when a callback returns. BeginTx and Commit are explicit. sql.TxOptions.Isolation is passed to BeginTx in the explicit case.

MG-02.held.reason: database/sql has no migration runner, migration history, or multi-process advisory-lock protocol. This adapter does not add one.
